chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
gentle swung shuffle, an unhurried strolling feel
sampled flute and soft reed lead playing the tune together
soft brushes on the snare with tambourine on the offbeats
small bright bell glints like lamplight on each lamp-post
cosy homely country lane at night between lit lamps, safe and contented
melody built on the hometown tune's rising lift, bouncing and skipping
seamless transition back to the theme
